name: Straight wall, walkway
description: 4 m curtain wall with dressed plinth, corbel table and flat coping slab. No parapet, use it under your own top.

name: Straight wall, crenellated
description: 4 m curtain wall with outer battlement (two merlons) and a low inner parapet.

name: Straight wall, arrow loop
description: Crenellated 4 m wall with one splayed arrow loop through the body.

name: Outer corner, crenellated
description: 90 degree L-shaped corner with an L-shaped corner merlon and a diagonal corbel. Arms end at x = -2 and z = -2.

name: Battlement, straight
description: 4 m parapet with two merlons, positioned for the outer edge of a wall top. Place it at y = 8 over wall_straight.

name: Battlement, corner
description: L-shaped parapet with a corner merlon, positioned for wall_corner. Place it at y = 8.

name: Wall with round arch
description: 4 m wall module with a 2.4 m round-arched passage (4.0 m high) and dressed voussoir rings.

name: Wall with pointed arch
description: 4 m wall module with a 2.4 m pointed (gothic) passage, 4.6 m high, and dressed rings.

name: Round tower, crenellated
description: Round tower, radius 3.5 m, walkway at 12 m on a corbel ring with 12 merlons. Arrow loops, courtyard door on -Z, wall-walk doors on +-X. Wall modules centred at x = +-5.2 join it.

name: Round tower, conical roof
description: Round tower, radius 3.5 m, with an eaves ring, bell-cast slate cone roof and finial. Same openings as tower_round plus a window under the roof.

name: Square tower, crenellated
description: Square tower 6 x 6 m, walkway at 12 m with corbels on all sides and a merlon parapet. Courtyard door on -Z, wall-walk doors on +-X. Wall modules centred at x = +-5 join it.

name: Gatehouse, open
description: Gatehouse 8 x 6 m, 11 m to the walkway, pointed passage 3.6 x 5.4 m through the body. Portcullis half raised, timber doors swung back, corbelled battlement, murder hole above the gate.

name: Gatehouse, closed
description: Same gatehouse with the portcullis lowered and the timber doors shut.

name: Curtain wall, crosslet loop
description: 4 m curtain wall with a crosslet opening, tapered courtyard recess and slit merlons; walkway at y = 8.

name: Curtain wall, square flanking spur
description: Square medieval mural projection with three perforated faces and a projecting wall-walk.

name: Curtain wall, round flanking spur
description: Rounded medieval mural projection, radial corbels and a curved crenellated parapet.

name: Curtain wall, postern
description: Small recessed side gate with a masonry screen wall, raised threshold and ironbound oak leaf.

name: Curtain wall, stone machicolation
description: Projecting stone parapet on stepped corbels with open slots between the bridge stones.

name: Curtain wall, timber hoarding
description: Covered cantilevered timber gallery over an 8 m curtain wall.

name: Timber hoarding, separate bay
description: Separate 4 m timber gallery. Set the origin at y = 6.45, z = 1 for a plain curtain wall.

name: Battlement, hinged timber shutter
description: 4 m battlement with a partly opened oak shutter. Use at y = 8 over the plain curtain module.

name: Norman rectangular keep
description: Rectangular donjon with raised courtyard entry, forebuilding stairs, paired Romanesque windows and corner turrets.

name: Round stone keep
description: Tall round donjon with battered base, staggered windows, stone crown gallery and a recessed slate roof.

name: Round corner tower
description: Round tower with wall-walk entries facing -X and -Z at y = 8; place adjoining walls about 5.4 m from the tower centre.

name: Corner bartizan
description: Corbelled stone lookout and slate spire over a corner curtain wall. Wall arms end at x = -2 and z = -2.

name: Octagonal watchtower
description: Faceted stone tower with quoins, splayed recesses, bracketed eaves and a slate spire.

name: Twin-towered gatehouse
description: Through passage with a raised iron grille, open timber leaves and a stone gallery between projecting flanking towers.

name: Drawbridge, lowered
description: Lowered plank deck between a stone portal and landing pier, with iron furniture and two lifting chains.

name: Drawbridge, raised
description: Companion raised pose. Portal, hinge origin and opposing landing align with the lowered model.

name: Portcullis and loft
description: Ironbound timber grille in a stone arch, with an open upper timber loft and windlass.

name: Wet moat, straight
description: 4 m repeating wet ditch module. Water at y = 1.45; join at x = ±2.

name: Wet moat, corner
description: Mitered 9 m square corner. Straight sections centre at (-6.5, 0) and (0, -6.5) in XZ; rotate the latter +90°.

name: Dry ditch, straight
description: Same scarp and turf bank profile as the wet straight module, without the water surface.

name: Fixed stone causeway
description: Cobble-topped causeway with a segmental barrel arch, wet stone at the feet and parapet coping.

name: Bailey partition wall
description: Lower 4 m stone partition for the inner and outer baileys, with a crosslet opening and walkway at y = 5.5.

name: Bailey partition gate
description: Arched stone partition with a recessed ironbound oak gate. Matches the bailey wall profile.

name: Bailey timber palisade
description: 4 m timber stockade with a turf bank, oak walkway and access ladder.

name: Gothic pointed arch
description: Standalone 3.4 m Gothic pointed stone arch bay with clustered nook-shafts, capitals, chamfered inner rib, radial voussoirs and hood mould.

name: Romanesque round arch
description: Standalone 3.5 m Romanesque semicircular arch with cushion capitals, recessed inner ring, stepped dressed voussoirs and keystone.

name: Gothic ribbed arch
description: 4 m span Gothic transverse rib arch with tripled wall-shaft responds, annulet rings, keel-moulded rib profile and carved keystone boss.

name: Quadripartite rib vault
description: 4 x 4 m Gothic quadripartite stone rib-vaulted ceiling bay on clustered corner piers, with diagonal and transverse ribs, stone webbing and central boss.

name: Splayed arrow-slit window
description: Masonry arrow-slit window bay with deeply splayed interior embrasure, chamfered exterior frame, wrought-iron security grille and leaded pane.

name: Gothic pointed tracery window
description: Two-light Gothic pointed stone window with central octagonal mullion, trefoil sub-arches, quatrefoil oculus and leaded diamond glass.

name: Gothic rose window
description: Circular Gothic wheel/rose window in a dressed stone spandrel frame with 12 radiating colonnette spokes, cusp arches and jewel stained glass.

name: Stained-glass lancet window
description: Tall pointed Gothic stained-glass window with ruby, cobalt, amber and emerald leaded glass mosaic, lead cames and iron saddle bars.

name: Spiral turnpike staircase
description: Stone spiral staircase rising 4.0 m per full turn (20 wedge treads) with central turned newel, cutaway masonry drum and helical iron handrail.

name: Straight stone staircase
description: 10-step castle straight stone flight (2.0 m rise over 2.8 m run) with sloped masonry cheek walls, slate bullnose treads and oak-and-stone balustrade.

name: Straight oak ladder
description: 2.55 m timber ladder with eight rounded rungs and visible wedged through-tenons, exported upright for placement at any angle.

name: Corbelled landing platform
description: 4.0 x 2.5 m arched stone-and-timber gallery landing at y = 2.0 m with octagonal piers, oak joists, flagstone deck and stone balustrade.

name: Great hall stone fireplace
description: Monumental medieval stone fireplace with raised slate hearth, brick fireback, carved mantel lintel, tapered chimney hood, iron andirons and hearth fire.

name: Stone & brick chimney stack
description: Tall battered stone chimney breast with quoins, lead flashing collar, brick shaft, corbelled cornice and twin crenellated octagonal chimney flues.

name: Slate gable roof bay
description: 4 m modular steep-pitched castle slate roof bay over oak rafters and collar ties, with 7 stepped slate courses and dressed ridge saddle tiles.

name: Clay barrel-tile roof bay
description: 4 m modular terracotta clay tile roof bay over oak rafters, built with curved 3D pan-and-cover barrel tiles and ridge cap tiles.

name: Reed thatch roof bay
description: 4 m modular medieval reed thatch roof bay on round pole rafters, with thick bell-cast eaves, braided straw ridge, hazel liggers and crossed gable finials.

name: Oak roof truss
description: 6 m span medieval oak king-post & arch-braced roof truss on stone corbels with cambered tie beam, raking struts, draw-bore pegs and iron T-straps.

name: Stone pillar & beam bay
description: 4 m castle stone arcade pier & lintel bay with octagonal shaft bases, bell capitals, corbel haunches, moulded stone cornice and iron tie anchors.

name: Timber post & beam bay
description: 4 m medieval oak post-and-beam bay on stone damp-course pads with curved knee-braces, chamfered summer beam, ceiling joists and iron stirrup straps.

name: Gothic stone gargoyle
description: Carved limestone Gothic winged gargoyle waterspout crouching on a stepped cornice corbel with drainage runnel, clawed paws, horns and roaring spout.

name: Iron-bound oak door
description: Pointed stone doorway with planked oak castle door, rear Z-bracing, scrolled wrought-iron strap hinges, dome studs, lock plate and ring pull.

name: Forged door knocker
description: Gothic wrought-iron & aged-brass rosette door knocker with pyramid rivets, heavy ring pull and strike anvil.

name: Scrolled iron strap hinge
description: Medieval wrought-iron door strap hinge with vertical pintle bracket, barrel knuckle, fleur-de-lis finial, symmetric foliate scrolls and brass rivets.

name: Forged sliding door latch
description: Heavy wrought-iron sliding deadbolt latch with riveted backplates, bridged keeper staples, strike catch, scrolled upright handle and brass knob.

name: Banquet table
description: 2.6 m carved oak hall table with four bevelled planks, breadboard ends, turned baluster trestles and iron corner straps.

name: Wooden bench
description: 2.0 m oak trestle bench with arched carved standards, wedged through-tenons and chamfered plank top.

name: Lord high-back chair
description: Gothic carved oak armchair with turned front legs, arched crest rail, tufted damask cushions, brass studs and finials.

name: Four-poster bed
description: Turned oak four-poster bed with panelled headboard, soft pillows, naturally draped wool blanket and pleated valance.

name: Oak bookshelf
description: Dentil-corniced oak bookcase with fluted pilasters, rounded-spine bound volumes with raised bands, flat stacks and a brass candle.

name: Oak barrel
description: 0.92 m bilged barrel with individually creased oak staves, riveted lap-joint iron hoops, bung and brass spigot.

name: Wooden crate
description: 0.88 m slatted supply crate with bevelled planks, diagonal bracing and riveted forged iron corner brackets.

name: Iron-bound chest
description: Arched plank-stave chest bound with four riveted iron bands, gothic lock escutcheon, padlock and side rings.

name: Grain sack
description: Heavy pleated linen grain sack with organic slouch, triple rope binding, ruffled collar and visible grain.

name: Arming sword
description: 1.15 m knightly sword with fullered forged-steel blade, drooped quillons, spiral leather grip with riser ring and bossed wheel pommel.

name: Medieval halberd
description: 2.31 m polearm with bevel-edged crescent axe, rear fluke, riveted iron langets and octagonal ash haft.

name: Heater shield
description: Subdivided parabolic-curved oak & crimson damask shield with iron perimeter binding, brass rivets, steel umbo boss and leather straps.

name: Armoury weapon rack
description: Timber A-frame armoury rack holding three halberds, two swords, a leaning shield and a steel kettle helmet.

name: Archery target
description: Ribbed coiled-straw target boss on a rope-lashed timber tripod, with linen target rings and three feathered arrows.

name: Hand-and-a-half longsword
description: Museum-style hand-and-a-half sword replica, 1.2 m overall: 0.9 m hexagonal-section blade with a short fuller, straight crossguard with central block, cord-ribbed leather grip and pear-shaped pommel with a peened button.

name: Scabbarded longsword
description: The longsword sheathed in a leather-covered wooden scabbard with brass locket and chape, wrapped by a sword belt with an iron buckle; stands on the chape, 1.23 m tall.

name: Infantry spear
description: Infantry spear, 2.4 m overall: ash shaft, leaf-shaped socketed head with midrib, nail through the socket, two riveted iron straps and a pointed iron butt ferrule.

name: Glaive
description: Glaive, 2.4 m: 0.5 m single-edged convex steel head with a back fluke on a socket with riveted side langets, a rondel disc and an octagonal ash shaft with iron butt cap.

name: Poleaxe
description: Poleaxe, 1.92 m: axe blade, four-tooth crowned hammer and top spike on a steel socket with four riveted langets, a rondel guard and an iron butt cap.

name: Bearded battle axe
description: Bearded battle axe on a 0.8 m oval ash haft with leather grip wrap; forged head with lipped eye, driven wedge, poll and iron cheek straps.

name: Flanged mace
description: Flanged mace, 0.6 m: round steel head with seven flanges and a spike finial, ash haft with leather grip and an iron lug with a wrist-strap hole.

name: English Yew Longbow
description: A strung English yew longbow, 1.9 m nock to nock, with a D-section stave of pale sapwood back and dark heartwood belly, horn nocks, a leather-wrapped grip and a waxed linen string at about 0.17 m brace height.

name: Sheaf of War Arrows
description: A sheaf of 24 ash war arrows, 0.76 m long with bodkin and barbed heads and grey goose fletching, bound at the waist with two linen ties and lying on the ground.

name: Plate armour on stand
description: Late-15th-century Gothic plate harness at human scale (about 1.9 m) on a wooden stand with square plinth: armet with bevor, gorget, breastplate with plackart, fauld, tassets, pauldrons, couters, gauntlets, cuisses, poleyns, greaves and sabatons.

name: Mail hauberk on T-stand
description: Knee-length short-sleeved mail hauberk with mail coif, gambeson hems and a belted crimson surcoat on a T-shaped oak stand, topped by a flat-topped great helm.

name: Great helm
description: 13th-century flat-topped great helm, 0.32 m high, with eye slit, breathing holes, and a brass cross of riveted straps; standing on its base rim.

name: Sallet with bevor
description: German sallet with long tail and closed visor slit, 0.27 m long, with a separate three-lame bevor lying beside it.

name: Counterweight trebuchet
description: Cocked 13th-century counterweight trebuchet about 12.6 m long: 9.5 m tapered arm with iron bands and rope lashings on a 5.8 m axle between two A-frame trestles, hinged stone-filled counterweight box, windlass, release hook and a stone shot in its sling.

name: Field ballista
description: Wheeled field ballista about 2.6 m long and 2 m wide: oak frame with two rope torsion skeins, iron washers and levers, bowstring drawn to the claw, a 1.1 m iron-headed bolt, ratchet winch and a pivoting two-wheeled carriage with trail.

name: Ram Log
description: Hand-carried oak battering ram about 4 m long and 0.34 m thick, hewn with bark left in places, with an iron striking cap, flange straps, three iron bands and five pairs of rope handles.

name: Rolling logs store
description: Six 2.4 m pine logs stacked 3-2-1 on chocked sole beams, two of them studded with iron spikes, plus a loose log and an iron-shod pry bar for levering them over the parapet.

name: Drop stones bin
description: Iron-strapped plank bin (1.5 x 0.8 m) heaped with rough drop stones, with four dressed 0.34 m stone shot and two loose boulders beside it.

name: Tipping pitch cauldron
description: 0.75 m iron cauldron of hot pitch hung on trunnions in a timber gallows over a charcoal fire basket, with a chained tipping lever, pour lip, ladle and pitch bucket.

name: Wall torch & bracket
description: Gothic iron wall plate with rivets, scrolled bracket, carved timber torch, wrapped cloth, embers and dual-layer flame.

name: Twin candle sconce
description: Gothic iron sconce with brass crest, twin flat-bar scrolled arms, drip pans and beeswax candles.

name: Iron wheel chandelier
description: 1.7 m flanged iron wheel chandelier with cross-spokes, turned hub, 8 dripping candles and 4 suspension chains.

name: Standing iron brazier
description: Four-legged scrolled iron fire basket filled with faceted glowing charcoal chunks and soft flames.

name: Floor candelabra
description: 1.5 m tripod scrolled wrought-iron standing candelabra with turned collars and five dripping beeswax candles.

name: Smith anvil on stump
description: Forged anvil with conical horn, steel face plate, hardy and pritchel holes, iron staples, on a hooped bark stump. Working height 0.79 m.

name: Hand bellows
description: Forge bellows on a trestle stand: tapered oak boards hinged at the rear, pleated leather band, turned handles and an iron nozzle.

name: Water grindstone
description: Sandstone grinding wheel on an iron axle between two A-frame trestles, hand crank and a water trough with a water surface.

name: Cauldron on tripod
description: Bellied iron cauldron with rivet band, bail and chain, hung from a rope-lashed timber tripod over a log fire in a ring of hearth stones.

name: Clay jug
description: Terracotta jug 0.36 m high with flared neck, loop handle, cork stopper and two incised bands.

name: Wine amphora on stand
description: Pointed 0.88 m terracotta amphora with strap handles, painted bands and wax seal, on a three-legged oak ring stand.

name: Pewter tableware board
description: Oak serving board with a pewter plate and round loaf, tankard, wine goblet and a table knife.

name: Butcher table
description: Plank-top butcher table with apron and lower shelf, a cleaver stuck in the top, a cutting board with knife and a rail with four iron hooks.

name: Stone altar
description: Marble-topped altar 1.8 m wide on a stepped plinth with solid ends, crimson frontal with gilt orphreys, linen cloth, brass crucifix, two candlesticks, chalice and missal.

name: Church pew
description: Two-seat oak pew with gothic-profile end panels, poppyhead finials, plank seat, three back rails, cap rail and foot rail.

name: Book lectern
description: Turned oak lectern with a tilted reading desk, front lip and a closed leather-bound book with a gilt boss.

name: Baptismal font
description: Octagonal stone font: stepped plinth, stem ringed by eight colonnettes, round bowl with rim moulding and a water surface.

name: Standing banner
description: Processional banner on a 2.4 m pole with cross-shaped foot: rippled azure cloth with a gilt cross, gilt crossbar, tassels and spear finial.

name: Wall-hung coat of arms
description: Heater-shaped oak frame with studded rim, azure field, gilt chevron and three gilt roundels, hung from an iron eye. Back at z = 0.

name: Leather-bound books
description: Stack of five gilt-banded leather and cloth bound books, two loose books and an open book with a fan of loose pages.

name: Parchment scrolls and rack
description: Pile of tied parchment scrolls with wooden dowels, a wicker scroll basket and a 3 x 2 oak cubby rack holding rolled scrolls.

name: Alchemist glassware table
description: Small oak table (top at 0.78 m) with an alembic and receiver, a retort on a ring stand, round flasks and stoppered bottles of coloured liquids.

name: Brass balance scale
description: Brass beam balance on a turned column and wooden base, two chained pans with weights and a leather pouch, spare weights on the base.

name: Hay rack and manger
description: Plank feed trough on four braced legs with iron straps, under a V-shaped slatted hay rack filled with hay.

name: Hay bales and loose hay
description: Three twine-bound hay bales (two below, one across) with a lumpy loose hay heap and straw scattered on the floor.

name: Saddle on wooden stand
description: Leather saddle with dished seat, raised pommel and cantle, skirts, stirrup leathers and iron stirrups on a wooden saddle horse.

name: Tack wall
description: Free-standing plank panel with peg rails holding a bridle with bit, a rope coil, a horse collar with hames and trace chains, and a halter.

name: Stone well
description: Round stone well 3.3 m high with dressed capstone, oak posts, slate gable roof, windlass with rope coils and crank, iron-hooped bucket and a water surface.

name: Stone horse trough
description: Dressed-stone trough 1.7 m long with four walls, a water surface and two iron tie rods with riveted heads.

name: Hand cart
description: Two-wheeled cart with iron-tyred spoked wheels, boarded bed, long shafts, front stand and a hay load. Shafts point towards +Z.

name: Wooden stocks
description: Oak stocks on sleeper feet: fixed lower and hinged upper board notched for three ankles, riveted iron hinge straps, hasp and padlock, plank seat behind.

name: Iron prisoner cage
description: Standing round cage 2.1 m high: sixteen bars, three riveted bands, plank floor on an iron platform, barred door with hinges and padlock, ribbed dome and top ring.

name: Wall shackles
description: Riveted iron bar with two eye plates, thirteen-link chains and hinged cuffs. Wall-mounted with its back at z = 0; place it at the mounting height of the bar minus 0.76 m.

name: Straw pallet
description: Low plank bed frame 1.9 m long with slats, straw mattress, linen blanket, rolled pillow and loose straw around it.

name: Wooden bucket
description: Stave bucket 0.3 m high with two iron hoops, rope bail on iron ears and a water surface.

name: High-warp tapestry loom
description: Freestanding oak loom with braced sled feet, exposed linen warp and a partially woven madder-and-indigo lozenge hanging.

name: Weighted lever cheese press
description: Twin-cheek timber press with a staved cheese mould, fitted follower, suspended fieldstone and nested whey bowls.

name: Baker’s kneading trough
description: Hollow oak dough trough on splayed trestles, with a draped linen cloth and three pieces of dough.

name: Bakery peel horse
description: A freestanding trestle with two distinct oak oven peels, tapered blades and bound necks.

name: Dyer’s skein horse
description: A braced trestle carrying three loose hanks of madder, woad and weld coloured yarn.

name: Masonry-set dye kettle
description: A rolled-rim copper dyepot seated in a circular masonry furnace with an open stokehole and a stirring paddle.

name: Coiled straw skep on stool
description: Raised oak hive stool with a coiled straw dome, hand-sewn binding and a notched flight entrance.

name: Chandler’s hanging taper carousel
description: Six radial arms support paired hand-dipped tapers above a shallow iron drip tray.

name: Cloister lavabo pavilion
description: Hexagonal vaulted arcade, ribbed slate canopy and a marble washing basin with four running brass spouts.

name: Bird-form bronze aquamanile
description: Bird-shaped bronze hand-washing ewer with a hollow beak, feathered wings, dorsal filling mouth and arched handle.

name: Great spindle wheel
description: Walking wheel with a tall grooved rim, twelve spokes, a tangent drive cord and a separate spindle whorl.

name: Loaded floor distaff with drop spindle
description: Tripod flax staff with forked crown, bound stricks of fibre and a suspended clay-whorl spindle.

name: Bowed-pillar hall harp
description: Standing timber harp with 21 individual strings, bronze pins, curved pillar and diamond inlay.

name: Double-rosette table psaltery
description: Trapezoidal plucked zither with fifteen brass strings, open rosettes and low bridge rails.

name: Post-mounted courtyard dovecote
description: Hexagonal nest house on a braced oak post with twelve arched entrances and individual landing shelves.

name: Rush-capped block perch
description: Turned wooden block with a woven cap, swivel ring and a loose leather leash coiled at the foot.

name: Parchmenter’s hoop stretcher
description: Freestanding braced hoop with a pierced, scraped skin tensioned by eighteen paired laces.

name: Bookbinder’s sewing frame
description: Oak frame holding eleven folded gatherings against five raised cords, with tension nuts and a trailing thread.

name: Staved dash butter churn
description: Tapered sixteen-stave churn with three iron hoops, twin lid loops and a turned dash handle.

name: Rotary hand quern on bench
description: Stone handmill with bored runner stone, off-centre handle and a collection bowl beneath the work surface.

name: Herbalist’s radial drying tree
description: Freestanding drying crown with cord stays and eight suspended, tied herb bunches.

name: Wattle-edged physic garden bed
description: A low round garden bed with continuous basketry, seventeen stakes and nine leaf rosettes.

name: Potter’s tread wheel
description: Seated kick wheel with weighted flywheel, central bearing and an open clay vessel on the throwing head.

name: Updraft pottery kiln
description: Tapered masonry kiln with a genuine stoke opening, arch stones, chimney throat and resting billets.

name: Wash tub with linen and paddle
description: Wide hooped oak tub with pierced lugs, a wooden laundry bat and folded linen draped over its rim.

name: Linen smoothing bench and roller
description: Braced plank bench with a wrapped roller, ornamental handled mangle board and folded linen.
